posts.text: Nike's 23-year dividend streak is long, but the real shock is the 4.37% yield vs a 1.41% 5-year average 💵 $NKE
$NKE pays its next dividend in March, continuing a 23-year streak of annual increases that started in 2014 📅
The 4.37% yield on $NKE is more than triple the 5-year average, sitting well above the 2.33% high from that period 📊
Nike sits 77.8% below its 5-year monthly price high of $169.24, with a last known price of $37.56 on Oct 28 📉 $NKE
Among Consumer Cyclical giants with 20+ year streaks, $NKE has the highest yield at 4.37%, beating Best Buy and Lowe's 🔍
